title: Console request estimator and priority Q&A flow
creator: Asha Mirza
description: Problem: customers submit a wide variety of console/reporting requests (ad-hoc exports, scheduled slices, cross-tenant aggregations) and the current intake form produces noisy signals for prioritization. That causes long manual triage cycles in Support/PS and inconsistent SLAs for enterprise customers. Goal: build a lightweight interactive estimator and priority Q&A flow inside the Console to automatically surface estimated compute cost, expected turnaround time, and a recommended priority lane. The estimator will be used by Support and by customers during self-serve request creation to reduce back-and-forth and accelerate decisioning.
acceptance_criteria: A web Q&A flow in Console that guides users through key dimensions (time range, row cardinality, downstream format, recurrence) and returns an estimated compute cost and expected processing time in human-readable form
A rule-based priority recommendation (e.g., Self-serve, Concierge, Enterprise SLA) based on the estimator and customer tier
An admin view for Support showing the estimator inputs, underlying assumptions, and a trace link to the telemetry sample used

Estimator accuracy sanity checks: for 80% of sampled historical requests the estimator error is within ±30% for compute units and within ±1 business day for turnaround when mapped to historical queues
Privacy constraints: estimator must not expose raw customer data; sampling uses aggregated telemetry and bucketed cardinality estimates
decision_log: 2025-02-16: PM kickoff - agreed MVP will be rule-based estimator rather than ML to speed delivery and keep behavior interpretable (Asha, Jonas, Maria Design)
2025-02-18: Design review - simplified Q&A with progressive disclosure preferred over a long form; include optional advanced toggle for power users (Marta Rivera)

2025-02-25: Eng scoping - backend will sample usage telemetry and compute a cost estimate using current runtime unit-cost model; caching will be used to avoid repeated heavy queries (Lead ENG: Priya Anand)
2025-03-01: Security review required for telemetry sampling approach; agreed to use aggregated counts and no PII in estimator responses
implementation_steps: Design: produce UI mockups for Q&A flow + Support admin view (deliverable: Figma link)
Backend: implement estimator microservice that receives sanitized Q&A inputs, queries aggregated telemetry, and returns cost/time estimates and reasoning tokens
Console integration: embed Q&A as an inline modal when creating a new reporting request and as a toggle in the Support request intake UI
Analytics: add event tracking for Q&A start/completion, estimator delta vs actuals, and override decisions by Support
Rollout: behind feature flag for 10% of customers then escalate based on accuracy signals
